title: calculator
description: Calculators accessible via MCP with real-time collaborative sessions and shareable URLs.
summary: Calculators accessible via MCP with real-time collaborative sessions and shareable URLs.
offersHint: Calculators accessible via MCP with real-time collaborative sessions and shareable URLs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcpcalc.com/api/v1/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_calculators
toolsPreview.description: List available calculators, optionally filtered by category

toolsPreview.name: get_calculator_schema
toolsPreview.description: Get the input schema for a specific calculator

toolsPreview.name: calculate
toolsPreview.description: Run a calculation and get results + prefilled URL

toolsPreview.name: generate_prefilled_url
toolsPreview.description: Generate a prefilled URL without running calculation

toolsPreview.name: calculate_cas
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate one or more headless CAS expressions server-side (MCP-only numeric mode). Unsupported expressions return a GUI handoff link.

toolsPreview.name: calculate_cas_headless
toolsPreview.description: Alias of calculate_cas. Headless MCP-only CAS evaluator; if unsupported features are requested, returns GUI handoff details.

toolsPreview.name: create_session
toolsPreview.description: Create a new interactive session for any calculator and return the session URL

toolsPreview.name: get_session_state
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the current field values, computation transcript, and pending message queue for an active session

toolsPreview.name: push_session_action
toolsPreview.description: Push actions into a session's message queue (set fields, submit computation, trigger plot, etc.)

toolsPreview.name: close_session
toolsPreview.description: Close a session and optionally persist a snapshot of its final state
